patches_added.name: Skip splash delay
patches_added.description: Opens the app without waiting on the splash screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable tracking
patches_modified.description: Stops the install identifier from reaching Expo and usage events from reaching Google. Disables OTA updates.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks unlimited move views, goals and move cards, manual sync, earlier library updates and card customization. Disables OTA updates.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown, can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, and can offer a quality choice in more LIVE rooms. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown, can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, and can offer a quality choice in every LIVE room. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Waze alerts
patches_added.description: Shows the alerts a Waze on the same phone is tracking -- police to begin with, and any of crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- as pins on the map, with a chime and a note as one comes up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze Features. Waze has to be patched with Share alerts with Maps, signed in and open; in the background is enough.

patches_added.name: Share alerts with Maps
patches_added.description: Hands the alerts Waze is tracking -- police, crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- to Ungoogled Maps on the same phone, where Waze alerts in Waze Features puts them on the map. Nothing leaves the phone. Waze has to be signed in and open; in the background is enough.

patches_added.name: Stay awake in the background
patches_added.description: Lets Waze keep running in the background without a route for the chosen time -- Waze's server allows 10 minutes -- so that its alerts keep reaching Maps while you navigate there. Costs battery; Waze still closes itself when you close it.

patches_added.name: Bold and italic text
patches_added.description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide Notifications tab
patches_added.description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide People tab
patches_added.description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Stop MQTT logging
patches_added.description: Stops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messages, calls and active status share that connection and keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Dynamic Color
patches_added.description: Replaces the default Twitter Blue with the user's Material You palette.

patches_modified.name: DM Debloat
patches_modified.description: Hide call buttons and composer actions in direct message conversations

patches_modified.name: Navigation UI
patches_modified.description: Bottom navigation, FAB, tabs and bars

patches_modified.name: Post & Profile UI
patches_modified.description: Post actions, profile header and Grok surfaces

patches_modified.name: Timeline UI
patches_modified.description: Timeline surfaces: posts, threads, banners, recommendations and video entry points

patches_modified.name: Disable advertising identifiers
patches_modified.description: Stops Discord and AppsFlyer from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Discord from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry and touch logging
patches_modified.description: Stops performance tracking, per-screen smoothness stats and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops performance tracking and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.

patches_added.name: Boost splash screen
patches_added.description: Skips splash ads and the consent request and opens the app immediately.

patches_added.name: Disable caller features
patches_added.description: Disables the after call screen and hides its entry in settings.

patches_added.name: Disable rate us prompts
patches_added.description: Disables the rate us feedback screen and the periodic rate us prompt.

patches_added.name: Remove battery optimization prompt
patches_added.description: Removes the battery optimization request on the dashboard.

patches_added.name: Skip initial setup pages
patches_added.description: Skips the permission and call setup pages shown after the language selection.

patches_added.name: Stop hiding navigation keys
patches_added.description: Keeps the system navigation keys visible.

patches_removed.name: Skip/Boost splash screen
patches_removed.description: By default, skips the splash screen entirely on launch. Turn on "Boost splash" to instead keep it briefly on screen (configurable delay) Useless To Boost Splash Screen If You Select Unlock Premium Patch Too Use If You Want To Skip Splash Screen Entirely

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium features and hides the premium entry in settings.
patches_modified.previous_description: Unlocks premium features and removes ads.

patches_added.name: Kill Signature Verification
patches_added.description: Patches libmx-bh.so to kill signature verification.

patches_removed.name: Disable signature verification
patches_removed.description: Patches libc++_shared.so (arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a) to branch-to-self at the signature check call site, hanging that code path instead of letting it fail the app.

patches_added.name: Close duplicate tabs
patches_added.description: Adds Close duplicate tabs to the tab tray 3 dot menu. Toggle in Mod Settings.

patches_added.name: Hide fullscreen toast
patches_added.description: Removes the toast shown when a video goes fullscreen. Toggle in Mod Settings.

patches_added.name: New tab next to current tab
patches_added.description: Opens new tabs right after the current tab and adds an add-to-end button (+ with a down arrow) beside + that opens a tab at the end. Both are toggles in Mod Settings.

patches_added.name: Old style 3 dot menu And Extension Pinning
patches_added.description: Adds "Mod Settings" to the 3 dot menu: switch between the stock bottom sheet menu and the old style popup menu, and pin extensions to the search bar.

patches_added.name: Tab scroll button
patches_added.description: Adds up and down buttons beside + in the tab tray that jump to the first and last tab. Toggle in Mod Settings.

patches_removed.name: Old style 3 dot menu
patches_removed.description: Adds "Mod Settings" to the 3 dot menu: switch between the stock bottom sheet menu and the old style popup menu, and pin extensions to the search bar.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro
patches_modified.description: Signature verification is spoofed automatically if this patch is selected the purchase check passes.
patches_modified.previous_description: Only Use In V2.7.2. Signature verification is spoofed automatically so the purchase check passes without manually applying Spoof app signature.
